4-16-24
Claim received for a low-speed head-on collision. The insured's policy is active and the driver is named on it.
Claimant is represented by counsel, so all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
5-7-24
Reviewed the police report and statements from two witnesses. Both confirm the vehicle was involved in the collision
and that the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the time.
5-30-24
Photos from the scene and the other driver's account match the described impact. Vehicle damage is mostly
consistent with the reported force of the crash, though a few older scratches may predate this loss and will be noted
separately.
8-4-24
Nothing in the file suggests the damage occurred before the coverage start date. Prior policy records were checked
and show no earlier loss on this vehicle.
9-3-24
Claimant reported a shoulder injury following the collision. The injury is plausible for an impact of this type and
direction.
9-19-24
Medical records show the claimant had a minor strain in the same area several years ago, which healed fully. This
history has been noted and does not appear to be related to the current complaint.
11-12-24
Counsel forwarded the initial treatment records. Care followed a typical course, with physical therapy and follow-up
visits tapering as the claimant's range of motion improved.
11-19-24
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who confirmed the client's account. In each conversation to date, the claimant has
described the collision the same way.
11-21-24
Reviewed the latest treatment notes. The provider reports steady improvement and fewer visits scheduled going
forward, which is consistent with the expected recovery timeline.
12-1-24
File is current. Remaining items are the final medical bill and the vehicle repair invoice. Reserve will be reviewed once
both are received.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
